text: OpenAI Codex Plugin for the DeepSeek Harness 是面向 DSH Web 的 Codex 集成插件：它注册 OpenAI Codex 模型提供方，并在设置界面管理 OAuth 账户。主要功能包括多个 Codex 账户的添加与切换、用量查看、Codex 网页搜索、图像生成工具，以及为 agent 提供模型路由上下文和 OpenAI 文档技能。适合希望在 DSH Web 中使用 Codex 订阅并调用相关搜索或图像能力的用户。使用前需要 OpenAI Codex 账户；插件通过浏览器或设备 OAuth 登录，不需手工 API key。

OpenAI Codex Plugin for the DeepSeek Harness connects Codex accounts to DSH Web. It provides OAuth account management, usage viewing, Codex search and image generation, plus model routing context and OpenAI documentation for agents. Use an OpenAI Codex account to sign in.

  [openai/skills](https://github.com/openai/skills/tree/main/skills/.curated/openai-docs)

dsh-openai-codex-auth README · Features：The plugin adds a durable runtime-context snapshot that tells an agent its
active provider/model, the models advertised by the `openai-codex` adapter,
what Sol, Terra, and Luna are for, and which orchestration tools accept an
explicit model. DSH writes this snapshot at session start and replaces it only
when the active model or advertised catalogue changes; it is not repeated on
every request.

dsh-openai-codex-auth README · Install the DeepSeek Harness Codex plugin：Add it to your DSH Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
```

Then:

1. Open Settings
2. Click OpenAI Codex in the sidebar and login
3. Choose OpenAI Codex as the provider in the Models tab
